name: Gig Tax Pros
subtitle: Mileage, expenses & gig offers
promotionalText: Keep your driving records, review receipts and compare gig offers using your own vehicle costs and pay goals.
description:
Keep mileage, income, expenses and gig-offer comparisons together with Gig Tax Pros.

TRACK MILEAGE AND RECORDS
Start and end drives, classify mileage, add manual trips and record income and expenses. Optional driving assistance uses location and motion to help detect drives and remind you about expense stops. Review saved trips for accuracy.

ORGANIZE RECEIPTS
Choose or scan a receipt, review the suggested merchant and amount, and attach it to an expense. Receipt text recognition runs on your device.

COMPARE GIG OFFERS
Choose an offer screenshot or enter the details yourself. Review pay, distance, time and estimated costs before saving a comparison. Missing information stays unknown. Optional screen sharing reads visible offer text after you explicitly start Apple's screen-sharing control. You decide whether to accept a job in the original gig app.

PLAN WITH YOUR OWN COSTS
Set vehicle costs and hourly goals to compare estimates. Explore the getting-started guide and clearly labeled sample earnings and offers without changing your journal. Estimates depend on the information and assumptions you provide.

USE YOUR LOCAL JOURNAL
The local journal works without a client account. Review and export your records. Optional firm sharing requires an invited client account and a working, configured firm workspace. Bank and gig-account connections require separate provider setup and authorization; they are unavailable when those services are not configured.

Background mileage requires location permission. GPS gaps, permission changes and force-quitting can leave incomplete records. Use offer-reading tools only when safely parked, and stop screen sharing when finished.

Gig Tax Pros is independent of Uber, Lyft and other gig platforms. It does not automatically accept jobs, read other apps' private notification inboxes or file tax returns. Estimates are planning tools, not individualized tax advice or guaranteed earnings.
